name: Doki x2★ Konkatsu Party
source:
I want to get married some day...but right now it’s just not possible.
At least, that's what I thought. But now, with my friend's help, I am going to try to get married!

The men on the marriage matchmaking site seem to have their own special quirks. This seems like it could be fun. What's going to happen now?
translation:
總有一天我想結婚……但現在還不行。至少我是這麼想的。但現在，在朋友的幫助下，我要試著去結婚了！

婚友網站上的男人們似乎各自有著獨特的怪癖。這看起來可能會很有趣。接下來會發生什麼呢？
